data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of $30.256 million, representing a 6.24% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by benign loss development activity and a detailed review of prior year loss reserves, particularly for the 2019 and prior years of account. While the Technical Provisions table on page 20 shows a gross strengthening, the comprehensive claims development triangle and explicit narrative of "favourable improvements" support a release.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a contradiction between the 'Change in prior year provisions' line item in the Technical Provisions table on page 20 (showing a gross strengthening of $24.139m) and the calculation from the gross claims development triangle on page 19 (showing a gross release of $30.256m), which is also supported by the narrative of 'favourable improvements' on page 3. The claims development triangle calculation is used as it provides a more comprehensive view across all prior years.
